items.title: A quotient of a smooth space by a flat finitely presented group is smooth over the base
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that if a smooth algebraic space carries an action of a group algebraic space flat and locally of finite presentation over the base, then the quotient stack is smooth over the base (author lemma at source lines 7697-7703, label lemma-smooth-quotient-stack). The proof (source lines 7708-7725) applies the flat groupoid theorem, checks smoothness of the structure morphism after the flat finitely presented covering by the source of the action and descends (proof lines 7708-7724). The base change computation and the descent step are the substance. H3.
